interaction: Draw on a crayon-textured canvas (8 crayons, 3 sizes, undo, clear, arrow keys + Space for keyboard drawing) and press 'Stick it on the fridge' to pin your drawing into the fridge gallery with a magnet for this visit; a paper-plate clock of the day's routine highlights the current activity by your local time, and tapping any part of the day turns the hands to it.
notes: Drawings live only in the page (nothing stored or uploaded; up to 6 of yours, each can be taken down). Weekend and after-hours visits get a 'closed' reading on the clock. Menu and fees are samples; subsidy text is general information; the tour slip ends in an on-page DEMO stamp and toast.
